services.name: Homeschool Programs
services.desc: Nashville Ballet is thrilled to welcome our homeschool community for the 26/27 season! We love bringing students, ages 6-17, into the studio to experience the artistry and creativity behind our performances. Be sure to explore our Company Season and mark your calendars for the corresponding homeschool programs. Each program offers a kinesthetic learning experience, providing students with a behind-the-scenes look at an upcoming performance, insight into the artistic process, and an opportunity to create.
